activity_help_message:
This tool analyzes the Windows Security Event Logs (Logon, Logoff, Lock, Unlock) on the remote computer to calculate the time a user was actively using the machine versus the time it was on but idle (locked or with no session started).

Prerequisite: The 'Audit Logon Events' policy must be enabled on the remote host for the events to be recorded.

winrm_error_message:
Could not connect to the remote host.

Common causes:
• The WinRM service is not running on the target computer.
• Windows Firewall (or another firewall) is blocking port 5985.
• Your credentials do not have administrator permissions on the host.
• The computers are in different domains without a configured trust relationship.

Please check these settings and try again.
